description: Dependency updates (v7.5 Q3, owner 2026-11-26): weekly grouped pull requests, security ones at once, merged only on green CI. Nothing merges by itself.

next and @opennextjs/cloudflare are patched (pnpm-workspace.yaml patchedDependencies): pnpm refuses to install while a patch names a version that is not installed, so they are upgraded by hand with the patch re-made. Their pull requests wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
Renovate branches never get a preview: preview.yml skips renovate/** so a new package version never runs with the staging environment's secrets.

packageRules.description: npm minor and patch updates: one weekly pull request.
GitHub Actions minor, patch and digest updates: one weekly pull request.
Patched packages: upgraded by hand with the patch re-made (see the top).
